name: 127.5 — the host the allowlist is asked about is a strictly parsed one
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 127.5: hafen.http():request(url) parses the url strictly, so the host the consent record is measured against is the one an RFC 3986 parse produced -- a lenient url is refused where it was written, naming it, while an ordinary https one still builds and a file: one is still refused at the call.
